about: fk-counters' application mutants; each is judged by the example's tests, laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: fk2-at-steps-every-row
mutants.rule: A counter's signal steps its own row only (law RowSignalTouchesOnlyItsRow).

mutants.name: fk2-at-missing-key-adds-a-row
mutants.rule: A signal for a key with no row changes nothing: it never brings a removed row back.

mutants.name: fk2-remove-drops-the-rest
mutants.rule: A remove keeps every other row, in order (law RemoveKeepsTheOthers).

mutants.name: fk2-key-reused
mutants.rule: An add gives a key no row had before (law KeysAreUnique).

mutants.name: fk2-next-not-advanced
mutants.rule: Next moves past every key given (law KeysAreUnique).
